revalidation.cause: Stopped-job completion raced SIGCHLD; token matching consumed the following prompt boundary.
revalidation.fix: Observe foreground ownership and signal masks; retry the stopped-job wait status in a bounded builtin loop until it reports termination; preserve the next prompt boundary after a completion token.
revalidation.counting: Replace the six canonical case records with their revalidated results. Repeats add confidence, not unique case coverage. Other 193 modern cases are byte-identical fixture definitions.

failed_records.operation: utf8 normalize NFC|NFD|NFKC|NFKD; all 20 column conditions per line

exclusions.detail: utf8 exposes only full default case folding and default case mappings. Simple (S) and Turkic (T) folds, and language-conditional SpecialCasing entries, have no candidate interface; Final_Sigma is covered by unicode17-final-sigma.

U+0000 is a scalar value but cannot appear in a Bash argument (C strings end at NUL). Its 8 sweep assertions (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD invariance, casefold, lower, upper, title) are not executed; GraphemeBreakTest exclusions are in unicode17-grapheme-nul-unrepresentable. NormalizationTest, CaseFolding and the malformed vectors contain no U+0000.
GraphemeBreakTest lines containing U+0000 cannot be passed through Bash argv (C strings end at NUL); they are excluded from every grapheme assertion, not passed.
